metadata.title: Ordonnance n° 20-02 du 30 août 2020 modifiant et complétant la loi n° 18-11 du 2 juillet 2018 relative à la santé
metadata.edition: JORA No. 50 of 30 August 2020 · new art. 395 of Law 18-11: sponsor notifies any serious or unexpected adverse effect or new safety fact to the minister in charge of the pharmaceutical industry, the ethics committee and the investigators at the latest within seven (7) days; annual safety report; art. 396 investigator declarations
metadata.legal_basis: Ordonnance amending the health law (Law 18-11); the Journal officiel text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
